rugs.ai_description: This ornate Persian rug features a medallion center with intricate floral motifs, typical of Tabriz design, blending rich reds and golds with ivory accents. It exudes a traditional and elegant mood.
This rug features a traditional Persian design with intricate floral motifs and a detailed border. The color palette includes ivory, brown, and touches of gold and rust, typical of Kashan rugs.
This is an antique Persian pictorial rug featuring detailed scenic and architectural elements. It has a rich, intricate design showcasing nature and ornate patterns.
This is an antique Persian Tabriz rug, featuring a central medallion with intricate floral motifs and an ornate border. Its dominant colors are red, navy, and ivory.
The rug features an intricate floral motif with a central medallion, typical of Tabriz designs. The vibrant red field is complemented by an ornate cream and navy border.

This is a vintage Persian Tabriz rug featuring intricate pictorial designs and traditional motifs. The rug displays a rich color palette dominated by red and navy, accentuated with floral and animal patterns.

This is an antique Persian rug featuring an intricate pictorial scene on a red field, bordered by detailed floral motifs. The design depicts various figures and animals, showcasing a story or cultural scene.
This is a traditional Persian Isfahan rug featuring an intricate floral motif with a central medallion and a complementary floral border. The primary colors include ivory, brown, and blue.
A contemporary Persian rug featuring a pictorial pattern with intricate floral and animal motifs in pastel colors. It is framed by a detailed floral border, showcasing artistry and craftsmanship.
This is a pictorial Persian rug featuring detailed portraits and script motifs. The rug's intricate design and rich colors suggest a traditional aesthetic.

This is an antique Persian Heriz rug featuring a central medallion design with rich red, navy, and gold tones. It exhibits traditional motifs and floral borders, characteristic of its origin and style.

This is a vintage Persian Kashan rug, featuring a central medallion and intricate floral motifs on a navy background with red and cream accents. The rug exemplifies traditional artistry with a harmonious color palette.
This rug features a complex floral motif with a rich color palette dominated by red, ivory, and gold tones. It exudes a traditional Persian aesthetic with an ornate border and central design.

This is an antique Persian Bakhtiari rug featuring a central medallion with a rich navy field adorned with intricate floral motifs. The detailed border complements the traditional design, highlighting its historic craftsmanship.
This is an antique Persian Sultanabad rug with a detailed floral motif across an ivory field. The rug features soft tones of blue and rust, giving it a traditional and elegant appeal.

This is an antique Persian Sultanabad rug featuring a striking all-over pattern with a harmonious blend of red, blue, and ivory tones. It represents traditional craftsmanship with intricate floral motifs and a vivid color palette.

This vintage Persian Bakhtiari rug features a panel design with floral motifs and animal figures. The rich palette includes reds, golds, and blues with intricate borders enhancing its traditional appeal.
This rug is an antique Persian Heriz with a rich navy background. It features a complex geometric design with floral and tribal motifs, typical of traditional craftsmanship.
This antique Persian Bakhtiari rug features a central medallion with intricate geometric and floral designs. It showcases rich colors including green, navy, and rust.
This rug features a bold medallion center with intricate geometric patterns typical of a Heriz design. The deep red and navy colors create a traditional aesthetic.
This is an antique Persian Sultanabad rug featuring a complex floral and vine design. The color palette includes deep reds, blues, and ivory, with a prominent floral border.
This semi-antique Persian Heriz rug features a striking medallion center with a red and navy palette. Its geometric design and bold motifs make it a quintessential traditional decor piece.
This is an antique Persian Sultanabad rug featuring an intricate floral design. The rug displays a rich palette of reds, golds, and blues.
This is an antique Persian Heriz rug featuring a bold medallion center design with traditional geometric patterns. The primary colors are rich red, navy, and ivory, reflecting its classic aesthetic.
This is an antique Persian Tabriz rug featuring an elaborate central medallion with rich floral motifs. The warm red and green tones emphasize its traditional craftsmanship.
This is an antique Persian Tabriz rug featuring intricate floral motifs and a prominent floral medallion. The rug presents a rich palette of red, ivory, and brown with a decorative border.

This is a traditional Persian Tabriz rug featuring an intricate floral motif on a rich color palette. The design is highlighted by a central medallion and detailed floral borders, embodying a classic and elegant style.
This is a Persian Isfahan rug featuring a detailed pictorial scene. It showcases intricate designs with vivid colors, including a depiction of birds in a landscape setting.
This antique Persian rug features a distinctive pictorial design with calligraphic elements and intricate floral borders, in a palette of rich russet and dark tones.

This is an antique Persian Kerman rug featuring a detailed floral motif and pictorial elements with rich colors like red, navy, and ivory. Its ornate design and craftsmanship reflect traditional Persian artistry.
This is an antique Persian Tabriz rug featuring an intricate floral motif. The design is characterized by elegant vines and floral patterns in earthy tones on a neutral background.

A beautifully aged Persian Mahal rug with a central floral motif accented by a vibrant field and navy border. The piece showcases traditional craftsmanship with a rich color palette of red, navy, and gold.
This is a traditional Persian Kashan rug featuring intricate floral motifs. The color palette includes cream, blue, and red, ideal for classic interiors.
This rug is a vintage Persian Heriz with a striking red field and navy geometric patterns. It features a bold floral border, typical of Heriz designs, creating a traditional and timeless aesthetic.
This is a Persian Sultanabad rug featuring a rich floral motif against a navy background with a complementary rust and cream border. It embodies a vintage feel suitable for traditional settings.
This is an antique Persian Tabriz rug featuring a central medallion and intricate floral motifs, typical of traditional designs.

This is an antique Persian Heriz rug featuring a bold central medallion and intricate floral motifs. The color palette includes navy, coral, and cream tones, contributing to its traditional aesthetic.
This rug features a bold medallion design with geometric motifs typical of Heriz rugs. It showcases a warm color palette with navy, ivory, and rust tones.
This is a Persian Kashan rug featuring a central medallion with intricate floral motifs and a navy background. The borders are elaborate with complementary floral designs.
This is an ornate Persian Tabriz rug featuring a central medallion and intricate floral motifs. It showcases earthy tones with highlights of red and navy.

This is an antique Persian Serapi rug featuring a rich, rust-colored field with intricate patterns and animal motifs. The design exhibits traditional craftsmanship with a harmonious balance of color and symbolic imagery.
This rug features a bold central medallion with geometric and floral motifs, typical of Heriz designs. Its color palette includes rich rust, navy, and gold tones.
This is a vibrant vintage Persian Gabbeh rug featuring a bold pictorial design with tribal motifs. The use of red as the primary color, accented by blue and ivory, creates a striking visual appeal.
This rug features a bold geometric design typical of Kazak styles with dominant red, blue, and teal colors. It showcases a central medallion surrounded by tribal motifs and a colorful border.
This is a traditional Caucasian Kazak rug featuring geometric designs and bold colors. Predominantly red, green, and ivory, it showcases a central medallion with intricate border details.
This rug features a striking geometric design typical of Caucasian Kazak rugs, with bold red, navy, and ivory colors. Its complex motifs and vivid colors create a strong traditional aesthetic.
A vibrant vintage Caucasian Kilim featuring bold geometric designs in red, navy, ivory, and gold. Its tribal aesthetic is highlighted by the all-over diamond patterns and contrasting stripes.

A vibrant Persian Kilim featuring bold geometric designs in reds and oranges, complemented by patterned cushions that highlight tribal motifs. Its flatweave construction is ideal for adding texture and color to eclectic interiors.

This is an antique Caucasian Kazak rug, featuring a geometric design with vibrant colors typical of the style. The rug showcases rich red, navy, and gold tones with intricate floral and tribal motifs.

This is an antique Caucasian Kazak rug featuring a bold geometric design and vibrant use of reds, greens, and ivories. The rug exhibits traditional craftsmanship with strong tribal motifs typical of the Kazak style.
